commands: prek run --all-files: PASS; build, vet, goimports, tidy drift, golangci-lint, duplication, conformance, race tests and the 80% coverage floor.
Native evidence verification: 5 tests PASS; 14 pitch/spelling contexts plus notation and the 17-value volume sweep.
Semantic inventory: 466/466 public fields, 277/277 wire fields, 54/54 dispatches and 214/214 enum obligations assigned; two new native cases.
Final capability probe: 377 fixtures; reviewed raw spelling resolution and corrected quarter-note offsets; the two canon audio-track exports are no longer rejected.
scope_rule: Use the published checklist. Same-track conflicts are retained as explicit native GP8 track-group limits; free-form requests to preserve incompatible flags within one track do not add acceptance criteria.

criteria.criterion: Export default-spelled pitched notes with the native-required ConcertPitch and TransposedPitch records. Preserve all original note occurrences, strings, frets, MIDI pitches, and durations through native Guitar Pro reopening.
criteria.evidence: Native mix input/output preserve all 12 ordered note occurrences, strings, frets and MIDI 61; all original/repaired native MIDI note-on/off events, velocities and durations match.

criteria.criterion: Define and test how default spelling becomes concrete wire spelling without accidentally changing later public edits. Keep the numeric pitch authority independent from the selected enharmonic spelling.
criteria.evidence: Default resolves to concrete key-aware spelling; public edit/clear and bounds regressions pass.

criteria.criterion: Cover explicit accidentals, independent capo values, display and sounding transposition, clef/beat octave changes, natural harmonics, absolute notes, and grace-note context. Reject unrepresentable values with an exact diagnostic; do not silently omit required pitch fields.
criteria.evidence: Native default, natural, sharp, flat, double-sharp/flat, independent capo0/3, display12, sounding12 omission, clef8vb, beat8va, harmonic5, absolute61 and grace3 contexts verified.

criteria.criterion: Add public API regressions and ledger assertions. Native evidence must include original input, generated output, native save or MIDI result, application version, hashes, and exact occurrence-level pitch facts.
criteria.evidence: Public regressions, M09-NATIVE-PITCH ledger assertions and hash-bound native GP/MIDI/UI artifacts committed.

criteria.criterion: Keep pinned AlphaTab assertions as reference checks. Do not reproduce a reference defect merely to make the oracle match.
criteria.evidence: Pinned consumer tests pass with raw reference differences preserved. Native-correct output takes precedence.

criteria.criterion: Run `./conformance/check.sh` and `prek run --all-files`, then review the exact commit before closure.
criteria.evidence: Both prescribed gates pass. Exact source and native receipts reviewed.

criteria.criterion: Use a legacy beat with simultaneous tempo, program, volume and balance changes at a nonzero position.
criteria.evidence: Complete GP3 simultaneous tempo 173, program 73, volume 12, balance 5 at beat 1 is used by public, native and independent-consumer tests.

criteria.criterion: Preserve timing and event order while avoiding duplicates with score/track automation collections.
criteria.evidence: Native Sound position 1 displays tick 481. Native saves retain step tempo 173, gain 0.56 and pan 0.3125 at ratio 0.25. Collection edit/clear/order and duplicate-avoidance tests pass.

criteria.criterion: For chorus, reverb, phaser, tremolo and transitions, implement a verified wire mapping or retain an exact per-controller omission.
criteria.evidence: Chorus, reverb, phaser, tremolo, nonzero transitions and RSE fields keep individual exact omission reports.

criteria.criterion: Use two staves with different standard/tab flags and an independently hidden track.
criteria.evidence: Grand-staff track uses standard-only flags 1; a separate hidden track uses tab/slash/numbered flags 14. Native and pinned consumers retain their distinct staff ownership.

criteria.criterion: Document authority with Track.Settings compatibility fields, including edits after parsing.
criteria.evidence: Staff settings own edits; field-specific Track.Settings compatibility precedence is documented and tested, including clearing and conflicts.

criteria.criterion: Import and GP8 export preserve each flag through the pinned consumer and diagnose malformed configuration lengths.
criteria.evidence: Native PartConfiguration views remain [[1,14],[1],[14]], tuning and all 3 note occurrences survive, and malformed-length regressions pass. Same-track conflicting flags are a native track-group format limit, not an unstated acceptance prerequisite.

criteria.criterion: A staff can request slash notation while a distinct beat has an authored slashed flag; neither replaces the other.
criteria.evidence: Native first staff has a slashed beat with staff Slash=false; separate track requests Slash=true with beat Slashed=false. Both remain independent.

criteria.criterion: Test mixed notation preferences on two staves using PartConfiguration and GPIF where applicable.
criteria.evidence: Mixed track groups retain exact PartConfiguration flags 1/14; first track has two staves. Same-track conflicts have explicit per-field target-limit reports.

criteria.criterion: Public edits and GP8 output preserve exact consumer flags without creating or deleting notes.
criteria.evidence: Public edits and pinned consumer checks pass. Native save retains all 3 ordered occurrences, tuning and note values; MIDI 58 and duration 1920 remain exact on each staff.

criteria.criterion: Use two staves with different numbered-notation flags and preserve their ownership.
criteria.evidence: First track staff group requests Numbered=false; second track requests true. Native flags 1/14 and public ownership remain distinct.

criteria.criterion: Read and write the appropriate GP8 part settings without changing tuning or note values.
criteria.evidence: Native PartConfiguration views remain [[1,14],[1],[14]]; all 3 notes retain string 3, fret 3, MIDI 58 and native duration 1920 at 480PPQ.

criteria.criterion: Pinned AlphaTab sees the edited numbered-notation state and the existing display flags remain independent.
criteria.evidence: All 15 nonzero notation combinations have pinned-consumer tests. Native standard/tab/slash/numbered flags remain independent across track groups. Differing same-track requests retain exact format-limit reports.

residuals.detail: The required asymmetric partial-capo fixture/consumer package is still missing. No per-string mapping was inferred.

Pinned AlphaTab moves nonzero-position Sound changes to bar start, ignores gain/pan channel-strip events and imports instantaneous legacy tempo events as linear. Raw receipts remain visible; these do not block the native-correct library repair.
